demos.name: SaaS Access LAB
demos.description: Just-in-time, time-bound access to GitHub, GitLab, Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks and Google Workspace, with approval chains, self-approval blocked, a reaper that removes access on expiry, receipts, reference counting and nightly drift detection, the same for humans and agents: a simulation of the 2026-11-02 Ping release claims. Mock tables, or a Live local engine with a lab clock you move. Every product claim is UNVERIFIED on our tenant.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7250). Docker: HOST_PORT=7250 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock and Live are both loopback-only with zero outbound calls; the lab holds no credential for any platform.
